answer: Proof-of-Stake serves as a haven for network integrity by requiring agents to lock capital as a jetty against malicious scaling. By forcing participants to stake assets to validate, the system ensures that spinning up infinite identities is cost-prohibitive. Each identity becomes a precious pearl of investment that the attacker must risk losing. An adversary faces a linear cost proportional to their weight, making the marginal utility of spawning fake identities negative and economically irrational.
